name: Autogenerate site icon formatter
description: Link-field formatter that displays each link's site favicon, fetched from a favicon service and cached in public files.
project_description:
Update Name new version Automatic site icon picker (formatter) 

 This is very small module. It is working with Faviconkit js .

You can learn more about Faviconkit js

Test here ,

 where drunk-indigo-goose.faviconkit.com/ site_url / icon_size 

 Send request and download image if exists (if url is right).

 

 

 Advantages: 
 

 Easy to use

 
 Small size

 
 If image was downloaded already, it will not send request once more

 
 Draws only icon, text and icon, link and icon
